description: This file contains unit tests for CreateThingSubstitutionStrategy, verifying its behavior when handling placeholders and immutability in the context of creating and modifying 'Thing' objects with policies and access control lists.

classes.name: CreateThingSubstitutionStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for CreateThingSubstitutionStrategy, verifying immutability and placeholder substitution behavior.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that CreateThingSubstitutionStrategy instances are immutable.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenNoPlaceholderForPolicySubjectIdIsSpecified
methods.description: Test that the apply method returns the original command when no placeholders are present in policy.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenNoInlinePolicyIsSpecified
methods.description: Test that apply returns the command unchanged when no inline policy is provided.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenInvalidInlinePolicyIsSpecified
methods.description: Test that apply returns the command unchanged when given invalid policy JSON.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenPlaceholderForPolicySubjectIdIsSpecified
methods.description: Test that the placeholder in policy subject ID is correctly replaced.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenPlaceholderForAclSubjectIdIsSpecified
methods.description: Test that the placeholder in ACL subject ID is correctly replaced.
